Table 8 of the article: Sensitivity analyses (matched 5% budget; Experiment 1: mean over 10 seeds; Experiment 2: mean over 19 held-out states). The pre-set values are λ = 5 and a −3 to +2 day kernel.
Table 9 of the article: Coherence-gated correction (matched 5% budget). Experiment 1: festival-window FPR, mean over 10 seeds; Experiment 2: holiday-hour FPR, mean over 19 held-out states.

Table 10 of the article: Confirmatory hypotheses of Experiment 3, fixed before the data were obtained. Differences are FACAD-CG minus the comparator (median over 19 held-out states, bootstrap 95% CI); two-sided Wilcoxon tests.
Table 11 of the article: Experiment 3 (Diwali 2026), matched 5% budget, mean over 19 held-out states and 10 seeds. Transductive methods fit the scored period.
Table 12 of the article: Synthesis across experiments (matched 5% budget).

Table A1 of the article: Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. Experiment 1: over 10 seeds; Experiments 2 and 3: over 19 held-out states, median difference with bootstrap 95% CI. FACAD-LOSO: table learned without the scored state; FACAD-HP: exploratory combined variant; FACAD-CG: coherence-gated; real events: paired over 25 event days.
